description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange with effect from 24.04.2023 to 30.04.2023
categorisation: This gazette notification is issued by the Director General of Customs under the authority of the Customs Ordinance. It sets new official rates of exchange for calculating customs duties and other charges, and rescinds a previous notification. This constitutes a regulatory matter and the exercise of statutory powers, making it a clear example of a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5).
